captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable garden sign stake. It consists of a horizontal rectangular bar that serves as the base for custom text, supported by two parallel, downward-pointing stakes. The bottom tips of the stakes are cut at a sharp angle to easily pierce soil.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable garden sign stake with adjustable text. The user should be able to define the label text and choose from different font styles, with the sign's frame automatically scaling to fit the length of the text and featuring two angled ground stakes.
captions.factory: The design is built within a `difference` block to cut the angled tips of the stakes. In the `union` block, the `write` module from an external library is used to render the customizable `label_text` with variable `font` and height. Below the text, a horizontal support bar is created using a `cube` with length proportional to the string length. Two vertical stakes are added as rectangular cubes, and their bottom ends are trimmed at a 45-degree angle using rotated subtractive `cube` primitives.
